title: ArchivalQA: A Large-scale Benchmark Dataset for Open Domain Question Answering over Historical News Collections
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and evaluation of a question-answering dataset from historical news archives. It does not contain any components for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The analysis of the dataset's content (e.g., event categories, named entity types) is technical and does not delve into these domains.
